text_block_list.text:
Today is Christmas. In a rare coincidence, 
it was a day off, so I was planning to 
take it easy, but—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Could you pass me that 
chicken?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And grab that cider over there too! Thanks 
a bunch!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Sky-san!? Why are you trying to 
use someone else's Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~... Just a little bit won't hurt, 
right? Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
King! The pizza's almost here! The store 
just called to let us know!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ummm... It says it's for 50 people~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
F-Fifty servings?! Not five, but fifty 
servings?! Who on earth is gonna...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yep! We can each eat 5 or more slices!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Wait, huh...? What...?"

The trainer's office had been completely 
transformed into a party venue for King 
Halo and her friends.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...You're being way too noisy. I mean, 
yes, I did invite you, but—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Salsa Viiiiidaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Pizza Parlor
text_block_list.text:
'Sup, pizza delivery's here. I also 
brought thirty extra servings of fries!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah! Thank you so much~♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two?! Don't you think you're 
being a bit too selfish?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's all the cleaning finished!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was a blast. Well, see ya again 
next year!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What's that supposed to mean? You want us 
to host it again next year?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, nope, not at all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm lookin' forward to racin' with you 
next year too, got it? See ya!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly. What is with that attitude?
choice_data_list: You get along well with everyone, huh

You get along well with everyone, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmph! How so?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Every single year without caring about my 
schedule at all, you suddenly spring 
Christmas party plans on me... That's 
totally not okay, right?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Every single year without caring about my 
schedule at all, you suddenly spring 
Christmas party plans on me... That's 
totally not okay, right?!
choice_data_list: (You two must be pretty close, then.)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. Well, you'll be joining in 
starting next year anyway, so we can make 
it even more extravagant.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So next year, how about renting out an 
entire floor of a hotel for me? A lavish 
party truly fit for a King!
choice_data_list: Aren't you suddenly being awfully bossy?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's nothing wrong with me putting 
you to work, is there?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Because you're my Trainer, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Besides, judging by how things went this 
year, it looks like I can keep claiming 
your Christmas schedule just like this.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: So, let's have fun next year too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And that's why it looks like King Halo 
will be working me like a dog right up 
until Christmas next year.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. Well, you'll be joining in 
starting next year anyway, so we can make 
it even more extravagant.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. Next year, and for all 
the years to come.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I, King Halo, will continue to make full 
use of you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Today's Christmas party, the New Year's to 
come, even the races years from now.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I suppose I could grant you the right to 
watch the seasons turn by my side from now 
on."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't this the best Christmas 
present ever?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, show some more appreciation! This is a 
gift from King herself, you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Look Trainer, it's snow! Hey hey, have you 
ever made a snowman before?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And sure enough, that very evening, I 
ended up being worked to the bone by King 
Halo once again.
